statement: Every scenario is a prescribed-input simulation. Each number carries its source row id or the label prescribed input (assumed). No scenario is a validated reactor prediction. STRATO does not model neutron kinetics, control-rod motion, thermal-hydraulics, power redistribution or mechanical refuelling.
nuclides_not_meaningful: Ag-110m, Cs-134 and Eu-154 get no direct fission-yield source term (decision 15)

metadata.text: Scenario 1: normal steady-state operation

A fresh particle under constant generation and constant temperature at the reference conditions: the baseline concentration, inventory and release. Steady refers to the inputs; the solution does not reach steady state within the irradiation.
